svg.title: Behavior, messaging and AI insights module design
svg.desc: Academic and attendance data feeds two parallel tracks: behavior tracking and messaging on the left, and an AI insights engine on the right with at-risk flagging, auto-drafted comments passing through a mandatory human review gate, and admin-only natural language queries. Both tracks converge into the parent/student portal and the admin/teacher dashboard

g.text: From core modules — grades, attendance, incidents
